1000 concert tickets at $25 each were on sale. From the graph, about 150 tickets remained unsold by Saturday. On Sunday, for every 5 tickets bought the 6th was free. Sunshine School bought all remaining tickets using this promotion. How much did the organiser collect on Sunday?
During a sale, a 10% discount was given for every 12 chocolate bars bought (per group of 12). Each chocolate bar costs $8. Dan paid a total of $331.20. How many chocolate bars did he buy?

Eggs are sold only in trays of 30. Mr Lee bought some trays and repacked them into carton boxes of 12. He needed 6 more eggs to fill exact carton boxes, and he needed 26 more carton boxes than the number of trays he bought. How many eggs did Mr Lee buy?
